title: A direct case is a valid small entrance
when: When one change needs a specific one-off proof that does not warrant a reusable plan.
need: A one-off method-backed requirement can target an item or deployment subject without inventing a reusable plan. Author with the actual claim, phase, transition and target. For a failed case spanning host baselines, --replaces-requirement names the exact failed row; its same-key correction changes only that baseline and leaves siblings and evidence intact.
surface: Explicit delivery-proof intake; case attachment authority
gap: Review question: should the diagram show direct-case authoring as a side entrance, avoiding an implied mandatory plan-creation step?
